capabilities: Build visual topic maps manually or from one sentence via AI chat
Research, expand, and synthesize individual topics with Quick or Standard (web) AI modes
Draft multi-level outlines and style notes per topic type
Mark points on annotated images with anchors linked to topics
Export finished maps as a single shareable HTML file
extras: Setup details, troubleshooting, and known limitations are in a separate INSTALL.md rather than the README; AI usage may incur provider charges via OpenAI or Anthropic; requires Obsidian 1.13.7+ on desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to explore a big question as a visual research map where AI researches, expands, and synthesizes topics into notes.

relations.evidence: For AI features, install and sign in to Codex CLI or Claude Code
For AI features, install and sign in to Codex CLI or Claude Code

summary: Visual AI research map plugin that breaks questions into topics, researches branches with AI, and keeps results as editable Markdown notes.
